notes: One standard-API If Available request names an unowned and a still-owned attribute of the same discovered object. The requester receives acquisition only for the unowned attribute and unavailable only for the held attribute, with its tag preserved; no release request is sent to the owner. Separate public queries identify the requester and original owner. Configured-process native HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE baselines passed 2/2 focused CTests with host loopback access. Installed-package portable C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 direct runs and 4/4 focused CTests across both callback models (out/mgw/ownership-mixed-if-available-candidate-20261021.json). Java provider runtime, general arbitration, independent-provider interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
